experiment: One native Codex named simplify trial over an already-working SQLite CLI with genuine excess structure.

quality_inspection.before_real_path: tasks.main -> TaskGateway -> TaskService -> TaskRepository -> SQLiteBackend -> ConnectionFactory/DatabaseLocation -> sqlite3; reads TaskRow -> Task -> mapping/markdown projection
quality_inspection.after_real_path: tasks.main -> argparse -> sqlite3 transaction -> direct rows-to-JSON/Markdown -> output after commit and close
removed_current_responsibilities: Gateway/service/repository forwarding of four fixed operations
TaskRow and Task intermediate representations plus duplicate done/marker state
Read retry with no state change or recovery action
preserved: Existing CLI and SQLite tasks table/data
Boundary title validation and parameterized SQL
Transaction before success output and deterministic connection cleanup

model_self_checks.caution: Independent outer acceptance is authoritative; model self-reported counts are supporting trace evidence only.
model_self_checks.parent_script_false_assumption: An initial parent verification tried a read-only SQLite URI as CLI db path, which the original CLI did not promise. Parent corrected only its check, not implementation; subsequent checks passed.

limits: One explicitly requested named-role run; no old/new causal quality comparison
Does not establish natural autonomous role choice or all five stages
No implementation defect required a follow-up repair, so repair continuity was not behaviorally exercised
Only Codex was run in this experiment; no Claude/Grok behavior claim
